items.title: Earle Ellis
items.author: Jesus' Use of the Old Testament and the Genesis of New Testament Theology 1 - E
items.why: This source provides a comprehensive examination of how Jesus fulfills Old Testament themes, particularly in relation to Genesis. It addresses the portrayal of Israel in the context of rejection and aligns with the theological implications of Jesus as the true Temple and the commissioning of the disciples, making it highly relevant to the claims presented.
